entities.summary: Ibrahim Aqif Biçakçiu was an Albanian landowner and Axis collaborator, Chairman of the Provisional Executive Committee from 14 September to 24 October 1943, and Prime Minister of Albania from 29 August to 20 October 1944 during the Nazi occupation.
